description.value: Bowland is a fast-casual Mexican restaurant in Maple Ridge offering a fully customizable 'build your own' format across bowls, burritos, tacos, salads, and quesadillas. Ingredients are marketed as fresh and health-focused, with a broad protein roster that includes lamb, steak, chicken, butter chicken, falafel, tofu, and plain veggies. The franchise also serves smoothies and signature combinations, making it a practical stop for a substantial, customizable meal.
